title: Remote viewing Chernobyl three days before it happened

tellings.quote: >> Oh, yeah. Ahead of time. Yeah. Three day three days before it happened.

plain: Army Sergeant Lyn Buchanan says he picked up the 1986 Chernobyl disaster, the accident at a Soviet nuclear power plant, through remote viewing, which means trying to sense distant events with the mind alone. He says he saw it "three days before it happened." If true, the mind could see events before they happen, not just at a distance.
